# Phi, a systems language that proves memory safety at compile time

> Phi is a systems programming language that proves memory safety at compile time, with no runtime and nothing to annotate.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://phi-lang.org/): Phi is a systems programming language that proves memory safety at compile time, with no runtime and nothing to annotate.
- [Language Reference](https://phi-lang.org/language/): Phi from a file to a program: declarations, bindings, comments, operators and their precedence, statement rules, and the keywords.
